newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Paranagua Sept sugar exports up 225 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Paranagua Sept sugar exports up 225 pct.

text.p: Sugar shipments from the Brazilian port of Paranagua reached 212,127 tonnes, up around 225 percent from the 94,454 tonnes shipped in the same month last year, according to the Paranagua port authority.

The sharp rise is mainly due to the dramatic increase in bulk sugar exports to 116,862 tonnes from 32,764 tonnes in the same month in 1995. Bagged sugar shipments also rose to 95,265 tonnes from 61,690 tonnes in 1995.

The September total means that Paranagua shipments in the first five months of the 1996/97 sugar crop year (May/April) reached 596,233 tonnes against 278,868 in the same period in the 1995/96 harvest.
Bulk exports accounted for 301,864 and 88,232 tonnes respectively and bagged sugar 294,369 and 190,636 tonnes.
Bulk sugar shipments in calendar year 1995 reached 155,051 tonnes and bagged sugar exports 337,734 tonnes, the port said.
